title: Google\Cloud\OsConfig\V1\PatchJob\InstanceDetailsSummary
name: InstanceDetailsSummary
description: A summary of the current patch state across all instances that this patch job affects. Contains counts of instances in different states. These states map to InstancePatchState. List patch job instance details to see the specific states of each instance.

methods.description: Constructor.

params.description: Number of instances notified about patch job.

params.description: Number of instances that are downloading patches.

params.name: data.applying_patches_instance_count
params.description: Number of instances that are applying patches.

params.name: data.succeeded_instance_count

params.name: data.acked_instance_count

params.description: Number of instances that exceeded the time out while applying the patch.

params.name: data.pre_patch_step_instance_count
params.description: Number of instances that are running the pre-patch step.

params.name: data.post_patch_step_instance_count
params.description: Number of instances that are running the post-patch step.

params.name: data.no_agent_detected_instance_count
params.description: Number of instances that do not appear to be running the agent. Check to ensure that the agent is installed, running, and able to communicate with the service.
